responsibility: Declares the user-visible command-line options for the GCN backend and the generated variables that carry them into the compiler. It defines the -march/-mtune GPU enum tables, ABI-width switches, OpenMP/offload-related flags, stack and gang-private LDS sizing options, XNACK and SRAM-ECC controls, and warning options, serving as the source for GCC’s option parser and target option state for this port.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-definition file for the GCN backend: unlike gcn.cc it does not implement target hooks, unlike gcn.h it does not define the machine model macros and register/ABI constants used by the backend, and unlike gcn.md it does not contain RTL instruction patterns, but instead declares -march/-mtune and other GCN-specific options that generate the port's option state.
